text: A wall with a tooth missing. {lead} rebuilds it with no mortar and a great deal of dignity, and finds Bara Brith in the hollow.
Soft ground, a patient creature, and a lot of worms. {lead} brings up the lot, and under them: Four-Leaf Clover.
A glint under the water at the lake's edge. {lead} hooks it with patience and a bit of reed. It is Brown Trout.
A wall with a tooth missing. {lead} rebuilds it with no mortar and a great deal of dignity, and finds Glamorgan Sausage in the hollow.
